d: Suguna’s journey began with challenges that made the world underestimate her. Born as the sixth child in her family, she was a small, underweight baby and struggled to walk and communicate like other children. At Opportunity School in Madras, she slowly learned, grew and found her confidence. The girl who once needed help became a guide and companion to other children with special needs. But Suguna’s journey went even further. She discovered her talent for basketball, represented India at the international level and won a gold medal, proving that every person has a strength waiting to be…
